subject: Acme procurement weekly check-in / commercial path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Acme procurement - next steps and commercial path

Hi Jenna —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the procurement path: 

Summary from discovery:
- Use case: product search relevance augmentation across web and mobile apps.
- Expected Q1 traffic: ~120k queries/day, bursty traffic during launches.
- Security: data-in-transit encryption required, SOC 2 evidence requested.

Commercial / procurement questions we covered:
1) Payment preference: PO vs card — you mentioned procurement typically issues POs for platform commitments. Can you confirm whether this deal will require a PO or if corporate card is acceptable for the initial pilot?
2) Marketplace: do you need Redwood listed on your internal procurement marketplace / Ariba? If so we can kick off marketplace onboarding in parallel (this can add ~2–4 weeks).
3) Contracting path: will legal need a redline of our standard MSA + DPA or do you use a vendor addendum?

Attachments I’m sending with this note:
- Redwood-Quote-DE-ACME-20260212.xlsx (line items + seat/throughput options)
- Redwood-SOW-draft.pdf (simple pilot SOW, 3 months)

Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm PO vs card and the estimated procurement timeline (approval owner and expected weeks to approval).
- If procurement needs our SOC2 summary or vendor form filled out, I attached the SOC2 summary and can complete the vendor form if you send it over.
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min call with our commercial ops (Rishi) and your procurement contact to walk the process.

Would Wednesday or Thursday next week work for a quick procurement alignment call?

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0127
Redwood Inference

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Acme procurement - next steps and commercial path

Thanks Marissa — great recap. Quick answers from procurement: 

- Payment: Acme prefers PO for any multi-month commitments. Pilot may be possible on card if below $10k, but procurement will push for a PO if legal wants a standard MSA.
- Marketplace: we prefer vendors be in our Ariba catalog but it is not strictly required for pilots. If you can be listed, that will help the long-term renewal path.
- Required docs: procurement needs a completed vendor form (I can send), third-party security evidence (SOC2 summary is fine), and the commercial quote.

I’m looping in Carlos (budget owner) so he’s aware — Carlos, can you confirm budget alignment for the pilot?

I’m attaching the vendor onboarding checklist. I’ll send the vendor form PDF separately.

Best,
Jenna Park
Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
jenna.park@acme.com
